instruction_completeness_test.reasoning: Instruction alone does not identify fleet authority, seal tip, or register/seat coupling required to pass.

discovery_budget.discovery: Durable lease epoch and journal seal tip come from the fleet profile via the Go mesh writer; harbor/live map is a decoy.
discovery_budget.why_instruction_must_not_reveal: Naming fleet vs harbor or seal math collapses to profile transcription.

discovery_budget.discovery: Fixed-buffer registration must write broker-tree slots with generation equal to durable epoch; PrivateMounts=yes blocks fresh registration.
discovery_budget.why_instruction_must_not_reveal: Naming the PrivateMounts gate or fold_a turns the task into a checklist patch.

discovery_budget.discovery: Preflight rewrites naive unit/lease edits unless seal matches durable epoch; emit must fold PrivateMounts and seat tenants.
discovery_budget.why_instruction_must_not_reveal: Revealing rewrite authority removes the journal/preflight coupling.

instruction_specificity.reasoning: Reports OK health, stale buffers, wrong PrivateMounts, and preflight rewrites without naming fix sites or algorithms.

attack_path.summary: Frontier agent greps for lease/buffer nouns, edits PrivateMounts and harbor live map, greens healthctl, then fails preflight re-entry and durable epoch tests.
attack_path.reasoning: Without implementing seal-stable durable map and broker registry generation, preflight undoes shallow edits and buf_fresh stays false.

smallest_plausible_patch.summary: Correct fold_a, SieveB, and emit_c then run leasectl->bufreg->nsbind->ledgerout.
smallest_plausible_patch.reasoning: All three locations are required; any single location leaves a failing test subset.

collapse_audit.reasoning: Distributed fix locus, preflight authority trap, decoy profiles without ignore banners, symptoms-only instruction.
collapse_audit.residual_hardness: Agents must discover seal/preflight coupling and fleet durable authority even with visible CLIs.

topology_enumeration.summary: Register buffers, then durable lease/seal, then PrivateMounts seat+emit.
topology_enumeration.why_no_single_location_suffices: Registration alone leaves durable epoch and PrivateMounts wrong; lease alone leaves stale buffers; emit alone fails gen and seal.

topology_enumeration.summary: Seal durable map first so preflight stops rewriting, then register and seat.
topology_enumeration.why_no_single_location_suffices: Seal without registration leaves buf_fresh false; registration without seal loses unit folds on preflight.

topology_enumeration.summary: Seat tenants and fold PrivateMounts last after registry and durable epoch agree.
topology_enumeration.why_no_single_location_suffices: Seating without fresh gen fails buf tests; folding without seal fails preflight_stable.
